blurb: Cedar Creek Boats offers the largest fleet of boats and jet skis on Cedar Creek Lake. Guests can choose from various boats including pontoons, ski boats, and jet boats for activities like cruising, fishing, waterskiing, wakeboarding, or high-speed fun. Rentals are available for half-day or full-day periods with easy pickup at Park Alamo Rd in Log Cabin, TX.
extraNote: High demand; boats and jet skis often book up quickly, especially during peak seasons and weekends · Call to book or book online · Pickup at Park Alamo Rd in Log Cabin, TX · Now Renting For Summer 2026
